`type` is a slug from `list_element_types` (e.g. "character"). Optional

tools.name: search_elements
tools.description:
Search elements by name across ALL 22 types in the world named by your
API-Key header (case-insensitive substring match).

Use this when you know part of a name but not the element's type. Bounded to at
most 50 matches per type. Returns `{query, results: [{type, id, name,
supertype, subtype}, ...]}`

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_changes · Private data: get_changes · Public sink: bulk_apply · Destructive: get_changes, edit_links, bulk_apply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_changes · Private data: get_changes · Public sink: bulk_apply · Destructive: get_changes, edit_links, bulk_apply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
